V69_new_cues.edge_rule: A cue uncertainty region may straddle background. Do not require its representative nearest pixel, all region pixels, or the physical mesh corner to be target material. Named visible RGB shape evidence and ownership sanity are distinct.

executable_label_record.input_only: Actual unmarked RGB crop and observed-valid geometry plus explicitly provided initial q/L/roughbox (and only a separately admitted deployment query-set if used). Never reference coordinates, native/semantic ID tokens, generated delta, GT masks, donor ID, variant names or original counterfactual image.
executable_label_record.identity: New operational cue IDs do not correct old renderer r or establish native8 correspondence. Same cue/reference/uncertainty stays fixed over every q jitter and intervention.

D_E_U_self_rules.original_D: Root-reviewed exposed named cue/edge/body-corner in original source RGB, with fixed uncertainty and provenance. This pilot uses conditional AI teacher D, not human semantic gold. Pixel M4 and shape boundary provide sanity, not a replacement definition.
D_E_U_self_rules.controlled_D: Start from admitted D and preserve every uncertainty cell with alpha0. Off-cue paste can coexist with D; q may be background or newly covered.
D_E_U_self_rules.controlled_E: Start from admitted D, place a distinct opaque other-instance front layer over EVERY possible uncertainty cell (including edge/background part of its footprint). Verify actual resized/translated alpha1 over the full native region and bit-exact outside-alpha RGB preservation. The fixed reference is E regardless of target support at q.
D_E_U_self_rules.partial_or_uncertain: Mixed alpha, fractional alpha, missing original D, uncertain target/cue association, null reference, nonobservable uncertainty cells, or unknown front-layer identity stays U. Do not pick a new cover fraction threshold.
D_E_U_self_rules.availability: Store FULL/PARTIAL/MISS/INVALID separately from underlying reference D/E/U. Primary D/E training target requires FULL; MISS/PARTIAL is U for that loss, never E/O/physical absence. Out-of-frame q and out-of-frame reference are different facts.
D_E_U_self_rules.self: Independent source self-occlusion evidence is absent. Keep S unsupported/U; convex-cuboid orientation, same-target visible pixels and M4=0 cannot manufacture semantic S.
D_E_U_self_rules.pixel_audits: Exact q and fixed native5x5 M4 support remain separate diagnostics; neither sets or repairs reference-state truth.

independent_jitter_geometry.method: Independent continuous half-open rectangle intersection with the actual image footprint; does not call V69 crop helper. Uses root-frozen q0/L/box/13grid without searching.

practical_input_identifiability.exact_collision: Hash ALL actual model-observed bytes: prepared RGBcrop/valid/q/L/box and any truly supplied query-set/context. Full-image RGB hash alone is insufficient when the model sees only a crop. Record the q/L numeric dtype and repeat after any float32/feature preprocessing.
practical_input_identifiability.conflict_action: Quarantine every contradictory D/E input group as association-U; do not merely retain whichever GT reference happened to be written first. Keep collision ledger and reference lineage.
practical_input_identifiability.near_or_multiple_references: If a crop contains competing active references with different states and no deployment-observable association rule uniquely selects one, preserve association-U or explicitly change the input contract. No new current-derived ambiguity radius.
practical_input_identifiability.current_pilot: Same-frame approved refs f17160:k4/k3 are far apart; their fixed primary crops do not contain both regions. Exact-input checks are executable in the builder. This does not prove global identifiability, and a unique reference per training image is not a solution to hidden-reference ambiguity.
practical_input_identifiability.slot_policy: No native/semantic ID token is admitted. A future token or ordered query-set association may be useful only if it exists at deployment with a separately fixed mapping; it cannot be silently borrowed from GT.
